scenario_description:
Objective: Avoid a second dock trip by combining Elian’s planned packet pickup with a personal paddle return.
Emerging Need: A teammate offers to relay a return through the packet desk only after the club confirms that the desk can accept short personal items.
Decision Context: Stored gear notes establish the paddle’s ownership, packed length and return recipient; the desk limit excludes a similar long shared paddle.
Consequence: A timely handoff agreement can remove an extra trip without changing the packet-pickup plan. Once the teammate leaves, a normal separate return remains possible.

parameter.title: Rainwake packet pickup and open dock
parameter.description: Pick up winter race packet, confirm boat staging notes, and check vendor tables.

parameter.subject: Packet pickup vendor table notes
parameter.body: The packet desk may accept a few teammate-to-teammate item handoffs at next Wednesday’s pickup. Staff have not confirmed the table space or size limit, so do not leave items there yet. This is a free convenience, not a change to club inventory procedures.

parameter.content: I can pass one small personal item to Owen after packet pickup, but only if the desk agrees it can be left in my name and its packed size fits. I am not collecting long shared paddles or changing anyone’s gear responsibility.

parameter.subject: Packet desk short-item handoffs confirmed
parameter.body: At Wednesday pickup the desk can accept one named personal item per adult for a previously agreed teammate handoff: packed length at most 60 cm, no shared club inventory. Maya can take a qualifying item to Owen after her pickup. Reply to Maya by 16:30 today with the item and recipient to check agreement; no fee or obligation is created without her reply.

parameter.content: Maya has left packet pickup for Owen’s neighborhood and the handoff desk has packed away. She cannot take another item tonight; normal packet pickup was unaffected and any remaining personal return needs a separate arrangement.
